titolo: Why the Deep Amazon Is Still Off Limits to Humans

scene.testo: In the twenty-first century, parts of the Amazon remain unexplored.
Satellites can see them. Almost no one can reach them.
Some of these forests shelter people who avoid all contact.
Brazil has recorded more than a hundred uncontacted groups.
And the law protects their isolation on purpose.
But the law is only one reason this place stays closed.
The jungle itself pushes intruders back.
Heat. Flooding. Mud that swallows every step.
Rivers rise by many meters every wet season.
Trails vanish. Maps stop being useful.
Insects, snakes and disease make every expedition a risk.
But that's not the strangest part.
The biggest barrier may be one you cannot see.
Let's go deeper into the green.
